findings.current: The woman who had been his fiancée, if only for a short time—Dagger Hidden Flower Ju Hwaran—would consider everything connected to him an ill-fated relationship.
findings.defect: The assembled English omits Sama Pyo’s preceding thought that he cannot tell whether their meeting was coincidence or fate.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly says he has no way of knowing whether this was coincidence or fate. That uncertainty is absent from the assembled passage.
findings.replacement: He couldn’t tell whether it was coincidence or fate. The woman who had been his fiancée, if only for a short time—Dagger Hidden Flower Ju Hwaran—would consider everything connected to him an ill-fated relationship.

summary: Mostly faithful. One brief but explicit thought about Sama Pyo’s uncertainty over coincidence versus fate was omitted.
